answer: Make reputation accumulate slowly and decay with inactivity, so a fresh identity starts at dawn with no weight and must earn trust through verified work judged by unrelated established peers. Give each agent one credential anchored to costly proof, like a walnut that only cracks open after sustained effort, so spawning copies means repeating the same expense for every fake. Let influence spiral upward only through a public history of useful, attested contributions, making a sybil swarm pay the full price of legitimacy for each identity while honest agents compound theirs.
